proved: The research workspace renders an adversarial-review product surface over the same resumable job registry and collaborative archive/decision domain exposed through MCP.
The product selects 1 to 200 exact non-empty semantic blocks from one displayed Lexical revision and refuses to start after that live revision changes.
The product supports 2 to 8 independently configurable built-in provider perspectives plus explicit blinded-judge and compute-matched-baseline routes.
Before native authority, the product reports the deterministic 4N + 6 remote-call count and preflights only OS-vault credential presence for the exact provider set.
The native content-bound batch approval remains authoritative for research bytes, routes, graph, dependencies, order, output limits, and budgets.
The product polls the bounded job, names its 30-second heartbeat and absolute deadline, and uses the shared native cancellation path.

A completed product result remains transient until Share full review with project explicitly states that question, excerpts, outputs, baselines, provenance, and optional Drive synchronization become shared project content.

The product history displays the frozen question and sources, blinded independent proposals, cross-critiques, claim-level evidence audit, minority findings, compute-matched baseline outputs, separate route provenance, token and available cost accounting, and immutable decision history.
History refresh observes only the provider-neutral discussions collection rather than decoding archives after every policy-editor update.
Invalid or concurrent archive and decision state remains visible, disables decision actions, and never selects a hidden winner.
Record accepted and Record rejected append exact-parent human decisions only; product copy, tests, imports, and the mechanical audit expose no Apply control or editor mutation authority.

The product stylesheet uses theme tokens without hard-coded colors, the source/test files are registered as Penumbra-original work, and synchronized design, architecture, API, roadmap, data-flow, and threat-model documents describe the same boundary.
notProved: A packaged user completed or declined the real native batch-approval dialog through this product surface.
OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or xAI accepted a live product batch or returned compatible production responses.
Two physical installations synchronized and interacted with one saved product archive or concurrent decision branch through Drive.
A near-32-MiB archive or a project near the 2,000-archive and 20,000-decision bounds remains responsive and understandable in the product UI.
Provider billing, cancellation charges, rate limits, retention attestations, or policy behavior match local conformance fixtures.
Researcher identity or timestamps are authenticated.
A human accept decision creates, applies, or authorizes any policy-text proposal.
The adversarial panel improves correctness, evidence quality, decision quality, or human preference over its compute-matched baseline.
The product workflow has cross-platform accessibility, screen-reader, keyboard-only, or visual-regression evidence beyond headless markup and existing theme-token gates.
